verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an LLM-judge metric type that evaluates calls using natural language criteria, alongside custom Python metrics for full control, giving configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators for scoring agent outputs. This is corroborated by dashboards/A-B testing docs showing these metrics feed into broader evaluation workflows. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on benchmark of judge accuracy/configurability, and no detail on rubric customization depth or multi-model judge support.
